specs.title: real account creation, trainer save and reload preserve profile while map walking remains unsaved
two real browser accounts are isolated and a second tab replaces the first trainer connection
sign-out revokes the real session and a narrow screen supports sign-in and trainer controls
ordinary staged trainers have empty party and bag without a development grant
the explicit development trainer displays its saved source-backed party and bag on desktop and mobile
unavailable asset storage is shown as a failure and does not invent an empty saved party
field guide shows independently checked source records and receives only public reference data
field guide keeps keyboard focus and movement isolated, then restores deliberate walking
missing or invalid field guide data fails with rebuild guidance before the preview is ready
dialogue draws source atlas pixels including the accented POKéMON glyph
a missing source font dialogue.json gives an actionable rebuild error
a missing source font dialogue.png gives an actionable rebuild error
sound is opt-in, adjusts volume, and pauses for mute, visibility and window focus
Route 1 stops unsupported music and dialogue plays exactly one source SELECT effect
missing optional audio reports a recoverable error without disabling movement
source-default NPCs render and the town sign respects facing and dialogue focus
a source NPC blocks its tile, faces the player, and pages dialogue without leaking movement
stateful NPC interactions explain their missing behavior without pretending to execute it
walking is the default, Shift runs outdoors, and the house enforces walking
two browser contexts reach the real proxy handshake and render source content
walking obeys source collision, focus, reset, and integer resize
missing content produces an actionable error instead of a blank canvas
missing world manifest explains the required rebuild
a missing destination map fails before the player can enter a broken transfer
missing required destination scenery prevents a false ready state
the home arrow exit returns to the correct door without bouncing
Route 1 preserves boundary alignment, grass movement, and one-way ledges
transfer input is suppressed and losing focus releases held movement
the rendered player stays steady in all four directions (walk)
the rendered player stays steady in all four directions (run)
ledge lift moves the sprite while its camera follows the ground position
ordinary trainers retain anonymous preview and cannot enter the seeded shared-world policy
two real accounts see nonblocking avatars, source house transfers, and durable shared checkpoints
modified map bytes refuse shared entry and leave the scene frozen
Route 1 ledges, focus and menus stop input, and a fresh backend recovers the saved position
